about: The template's three frozen sample cases, written on frozenOn before any run: c01 asks about one of the fictional items the sample tool lookUpItem knows (lib/tools.ts); c02 and c03 ask general questions that need no tool. A case passes when its answer calls exactly the expected tools, in order, and its reply holds every expected phrase, ignoring case (lib/eval/project.ts). The expected phrases are ones the mock model's fixed answers hold, so the mock run passes every case; no real model has answered them. A project replaces these cases with its own, frozen before its first run. The file's SHA-256 is in measurements/cases.sha256; lib/eval/cases.test.ts fails on any edit that does not update it.
